description: Change several line items on a job in one call - each one's name, description, kind, quantity, price or cost. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Prices in DOLLARS - this server converts to Housecall Pro's integer cents for you. Reach for this rather than hcp_update_job_line_item whenever more than one row is changing: it is a single request Housecall Pro applies to the whole list, where the single-item tool is one request per row and can leave a job half-repriced if a later one fails. Use the single-item tool when exactly one row is changing. Housecall Pro requires the id and the name on every item in the list, so pass the name even when only a price is changing. A job's line-item list also carries rows Housecall Pro added itself, an automatic tax line among them, so check what a row is before touching it rather than working through the whole list. Changing line items changes the job's total and its derived description. Nothing is sent to the customer by itself, though a customer who opens an invoice they were already sent sees the new figures.

line_items.description: The items to change, each carrying its own line item id (rli_...)

id.description: Line item id (rli_...), from the job record or an hcp_add_job_line_items response

name.description: Required by Housecall Pro on every item, even when it is not changing

unit_cost_dollars.description: Your cost per unit in dollars
